pool.text: Habbus ibn Maksan appointed Zawi ben Ziri his secretary with tax responsibilities.
The Granada massacre ended the Golden age of Jewish culture in Spain.
The Alcázar Genil was built as a remnant of the Almohad period.
Muhammad I Ibn al-Ahmar began construction on the Alhambra complex.
The Madrasa al-Yusufiyya was founded as the only major madrasa built in al-Andalus.
Emir Muhammad XI surrendered control of the Emirate to the Catholic Monarchs.
The Constitutive Charter of the Ayuntamiento of Granada was conceded.
Granada was one of the cities that joined the Nationalist uprising.
The Alhambra and the Generalife were declared UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
A monument honoring Judah ben Saul ibn Tibbon was established in Granada.
The UNESCO World Heritage Site encompassing the Alhambra was extended.
The FIS Alpine World Ski Championships were held nearby at Sierra Nevada.
The new mosque was inaugurated on the summit of the neighborhood of Albayzin.
The Hospital of the Health Campus was inaugurated completely in July.
Service on the Granada metro light rail network finally started.
Granada exported a total of $1.3 billion products.
Salvador resigned and was succeeded by Socialist Francisco Cuenca as mayor.
Marifrán Carazo of the PP ousted Cuenca in the Spanish local elections.
The population of Granada reached 233,532 as the 20th-largest city in Spain.
A total of 34,904 people living in Granada were born outside Spain.
